info.name: Tataiya App API
info.description:
Mobile app (Flutter) API collection for Tataiya.

Base URL: https://tataiya.in  (or http://localhost:3000)
Auth header: Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}

After login/OTP, copy accessToken into the collection variable.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Email/OTP/social login — used by both app and website

request.description: Send OTP via Message Central (Admin Settings keys). Returns verificationId.
Verify Message Central OTP (pass verificationId from send-otp) and receive accessToken
email field accepts email OR phone

item.name: Catalog & Content
item.description: Public catalog endpoints shared by clients

item.name: Engagement
item.description: Likes, views, wishlist, reviews — Bearer required where noted
